faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSL Nurse (Male) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSL Nurse (Male) position is 03 October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Nurse (Male) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three-year Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery and hold a valid registration as RN & RM with the Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council (KNMC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Nurse (Male) post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: For General and OBC category candidates, the application fee is ₹ 300/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Nurse (Male) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 23,300/- to Rs. 24,800/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSL Nurse (Male) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Certificate Verification, an Objective Type Test, and a Practical Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at Cochin Shipyard.
